title: Antonio Sanchez: Gathering Sky Lesson (video, captions read via chordu.com)
notes: His account of The Gathering Sky: 'a West African vibe' at the start, then 'like into 3-4 samba, sort of, when the guitar solo starts'; the drum solo 'Most of it is gonna be based around clave. The 4-4 clave, which is like a 3-2 rumba clave'; 'the 5-4 clave ... another cowbell right next to my right foot. And I play beat number one of each 5-4 bar on that one'; a 7/8 clave, 'The first bar is 2-3 clave. The second bar turns around into a 3-2 clave'; 'While playing the clave on the hi-hat, if I hit with my heel this bell'; 'I let go of my lower body playing the clave, and then I can play stuff in another time or another tempo on top.' The captions, as extracted; the video not watched.

title: Antonio Sanchez's Jazz Is a Beat or Two Ahead of the Pack (George Varga, Creators Syndicate, 28 September 2008)
notes: Metheny 'composed The Gathering Sky specifically to take advantage of Sanchez's ... ability to perform clave ... with a cowbell that he plays with his left foot'; Peart and Copeland major inspirations. Read in full.

title: Antonio Sanchez, Migration (review, Ken Micallef, Modern Drummer, 15 December 2007)
notes: 'From foot pedal–executed clave patterns to blazingly fast and intricate drumset figures'; no track named. Read in full.

title: Samba Independence Tips with Antonio Sanchez (Modern Drummer, 30 June 2015)
notes: His samba ostinato: 'constant 8th notes on the ride, a dotted 8th/16th-note figure on the bass drum, and offbeat chicks with the hi-hat foot', the left hand free. The text read; the video not watched.

title: Master Series: Antonio Sanchez (Hudson Music, product page)
notes: The DVD covers left-foot clave and odd-meter clave, on his small jazz kit and his Metheny Group kit. The page only; the booklet's examples were not read from a legitimate copy.

title: Antonio Sanchez Talks About His New Album, Bad Hombre (Joe Bosso, DRUM!, 31 August 2017)
notes: On Fire Trail/Distant Glow the drums in 5/4 against a 4/4 sequence, 'you'd get this overlap at the bar length before it would come back to the same place'; with Danilo Pérez 'We would play with the clave, and I would play this big, wide 5/4'. A Yamaha PHX kit. Read in full.

title: 5 Pieces of Gear: Antonio Sanchez's Essential Cymbals (DRUM!, 12 October 2018)
notes: A 1950s Zildjian K ride, 'this incredibly dark, luscious sound'; thin old K and A hi-hats; two 8in splashes as an extra hat; a Trashformer on an Oriental China. Read in full.

title: Interview mit Antonio Sánchez (Gunther Matejka, bonedo.de, 26 August 2022)
notes: 'Tony Williams einer meiner wichtigsten Einflüsse. Aber auch Roy Haynes, Jack DeJohnette, Elvin Jones, Max Roach, Philly Joe Jones'; Weckl and Colaiuta for fusion. Read in full.

title: Antonio Sanchez Speaks of Now (Berklee Today, Spring 2003)
notes: Rock first, then videos of Gadd, Weckl and Colaiuta; his Berklee teachers; the Speaking of Now sessions and The Gathering Sky's drum solo. Read in full.

title: Antonio Sánchez about drums, drumming (15 Questions)
notes: 'Deeply influenced by Afro-Cuban and Mexican rhythmic concepts'; Yamaha for over 25 years, the PHX. Read in full.

title: Antonio Sánchez (drummer) - Wikipedia
notes: Born 1 November 1971, Mexico City; the National Conservatory, Berklee, New England Conservatory; Danilo Pérez recommended him in 1997; Pat Metheny Group from Speaking of Now; leader on CAM Jazz; the Birdman score.

title: Speaking of Now - Wikipedia
notes: Pat Metheny Group, Warner Bros., 2002: his first record with the group; The Gathering Sky, You, Afternoon, As It Is.

title: Migration (Antonio Sánchez album) - Wikipedia
notes: CAM Jazz, recorded January 2007: Chris Potter, David Sánchez, Scott Colley, with Chick Corea and Pat Metheny on some tracks.

title: Pat Metheny Group: You, drums (Songsterr, Michael Dybala)
notes: Human. At 98 (95 from bar 80, 105 from bar 90); bars 69-74: a ride in eighths and paired sixteenths, the snare on the 'and' of 2 and on 4, the kick across it.

title: Pat Metheny Group: Afternoon, drums (Songsterr, Brady94)
notes: Human. At 105: a two-bar kick-and-snare figure under hat eighths, later the ride (bars 1-2, 37-38).

title: Pat Metheny Group: As It Is (Speaking of Now Live), drums (Songsterr, Allen Harding)
notes: Human. Bar 9 read; its tempo not, and songbpm's 136 for the studio take is algorithmic. Left out.
